item.title: A message from Ms. Clune:
item.description: Gr. 7/8 Cross Country Athletes please come to school dressed in your athletic gear with your Ravens jersey, shoes, water, and lunch tomorrow. RHS Race here we come!

item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: Attention high school music ministry! There will be a music practice in the chapel today at 10:35AM. New members are welcome!

item.title: A message from Guidance:
item.description: At STA, we have a partnership with the Canadian Armed Forces to offer a High School Co-op Program. They will be visiting on October 20th during period 4 to discuss the co-op Program, career opportunities, training, and the application process. If you're interested in attending, sign up in the guidance office!

item.title: A message from: Mrs. Curtis
item.description: Grade 8 girls signed up for the Skilled Trades Workshops are asked to please return their permission forms to Mrs. Curtis this week.

item.title: A message from the office.
item.description: Please remember that you must lock your lockers at all times during the day. You are responsible for your lock--it is a $10.00 replacement fee if it is lost or broken.

item.title: A message from Ms. Baron:
item.description: There will be a quick Best Buddies meeting at lunch today in rm 127. See you there!

item.title: A message from Mr. Cornellier and Mr. Letendre.
item.description: The first junior and senior girls' volleyball tryout will be held this Friday after school. A sign up sheet is posted in the gym foyer. There is no volleyball session on Wednesday of this week.
